name: @flax/fetch
description: Optional standard Fetch environment for Flax sessions.

scripts.typecheck: tsc --project tsconfig.npm.json --noEmit && tsc --project tsconfig.host.json && tsc --project tsconfig.test.json
scripts.build: node --eval "import { rmSync } from 'node:fs'; rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc --project tsconfig.npm.json --emitDeclarationOnly
